bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. All bags are searched, and bags that are not clear get additional screening.
prohibited: Large bags and backpacks (must go to Coat Check)
Professional cameras or detachable lenses without a media pass
Weapons, including pepper spray and knives
Laser pointers, glow sticks, LED gloves
bagPolicy.note: Large bags and backpacks must be checked at Coat Check. Medication must be in its original container with a name matching your photo ID; the venue cannot store medication.

parking.note: The venue does not manage nearby parking. Use its ParkWhiz link to reserve a space.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Irving Plaza. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: Bars sell beer and cocktails. Pay by card or Apple Pay. Free cash-to-card conversion is available at coat check.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Ramp access, an elevator, and accessible restrooms are available. Arrive early for the accessible viewing area. Each guest may bring one companion.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Ticketmaster will call opens at door time or meet-and-greet check-in time. Bring photo ID and the credit card used to buy tickets. Artist guest lists may not be available until doors open.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors usually open one hour before showtime.
